question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
WITH first_rental_payment AS (
  SELECT 
    p.customer_id,
    p.rental_id,
    p.payment_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date ASC) as rn
  FROM payment p
  WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
),
first_rental AS (
  SELECT 
    frp.customer_id,
    frp.rental_id,
    frp.payment_date,
    r.inventory_id,
    r.rental_date
  FROM first_rental_payment frp
  JOIN rental r ON frp.rental_id = r.rental_id
  WHERE frp.rn = 1
),
first_movie_rating AS (
  SELECT 
    fr.customer_id,
    f.rating,
    fr.rental_id as first_rental_id
  FROM first_rental fr
  JOIN inventory i ON fr.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(p.amount) as total_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) as total_rentals
  FROM customer c
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
  fmr.rating,
  AVG(ct.total_amount) as avg_total_amount,
  AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_rating fmr
JOIN customer_totals ct ON fmr.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY fmr.rating
ORDER BY fmr.rating;
